snippet.title: EVERSPACE 2 | Titans DLC — Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
EVERSPACE 2: Titans brings massive repeatable encounters to the star systems of Cluster 34 along with new enemies and a pile of loot to collect. Discover two exciting storylines packed with fresh gameplay mechanics alongside a cast of new and returning characters! Out now on Steam, GOG, Microsoft Store, Xbox, and PlayStation.

Available now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873460/EVERSPACE_2__Titans/
Get it on GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/everspace_2_titans
Out Now on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-ca/product/UP1562-PPSA15671_00-0628003451656117
Play on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/everspace-2-titans/9PLC3RPFTZ1W

Follow us on: 
https://www.facebook.com/everspace.game
https://bsky.app/profile/everspace.game
https://twitter.com/everspace_game 
https://www.instagram.com/everspace_game/
https://www.reddit.com/r/EverspaceGame/ 
http://discord.gg/rockfishgames

Music used in and officially licensed for the trailer through positionmusic.com: "Into the Wild" by Kings & Creatures
